Class JacksonOpenApiJsonMapper

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.openapi.jackson.JacksonOpenApiJsonMapper
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.json.JsonMapper
public final class JacksonOpenApiJsonMapper extends Object implements io.micronaut.json.JsonMapper
A JsonMapper backed by a Jackson ObjectMapper.

Trees are exchanged as Micronaut JsonNode instances, converted through plain Java maps, lists and scalars. Jackson exceptions are rethrown as IOException, matching the JsonMapper contract.

Since:
8.0.0
